notes.title: Update 0.3.5: Adjust Hero Obtaining Mechanism
notes.notes: [p][b]Optimization[/b][/p][p]-Remove hero story levels[/p][p]As mentioned in the previous update, the game is now adjusted to emphasize combat, then the significance of the story becomes weaker.[/p][p]Although the story levels can be used to introduce the reasons why the heroes join the battle and show the world view. On the one hand, my time is indeed limited. Instead of releasing a half-baked narrative, it is better to focus on the battle itself. On the other hand, when players first start playing and come into contact with the story levels, them may feel that the game focuses on the narrative, but then it disappears later. So I hope that after removing it, the gaming experience will be clearer.[/p][p]I started to conceive the world view many years ago and wrote a lot of text for it. It's a pity to remove it, but I think it's the right direction. After this game is finished, I will have the opportunity to make an SRPG that focus on narrative.[/p][p]After that, getting a hero will happen with a certain probability when obtaining a new unit. And different captains will have different short plots after finishing a run.[/p][p][/p][p]-Adjust first hero choose UI[/p][p]The page flipping UI was not very intuitive, now all heroes are listed at once.[/p][p]The first 2 teammates selection has been changed from 2 to 3, which is consistent with the game process and makes it easier to achieve desired build.[/p][p][/p][p]-Heroes in non-combat scene always face right[/p][p]I guess it's just my obsessive compulsive disorder... Just kidding. I just want to express that the team is always moving in one direction. I didn't pay attention to this detail before.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Next Update[/b][/p][p]-Adventure Mode Optimization[/p][p]After adding epic relics, the experience of adventure mode has changed a lot.[/p][p]The original intention of adventure mode design was to add roguelite elements. So that the equipment of heroes can be retained. So obtaining heroes means gaining strong combat force. Clues are also designed for this purpose. After adding relics, the roguelite elements has become weaker. Therefore, the meaning of the adventure mode needs to be rethought.[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.3.1：Adjust Unit Base Attributes
notes.notes:
I was chatting with a designer friend some time ago, and he told me about his feelings about the game. He thought it was a very extreme game state, and a wrong move might lead to failure.
His words woke me up. I do tend to make this kind of game with a bit of an extreme state. So it does not add many unit growing up elements like traditional SRPGs, nor does it emphasize economy and operation like many strategy-oriented games, nor does it have a gameplay similar to the delicate decryption of "Into The Breach". I hope to have some of my own characteristics.
In fact, "Fountain" is currently more like "Slay the Spire". Especially after the addition of "Rare Relics", and the subsequent planned addition of "Epic Relics" and "Food" systems. It is more inclined to emphasize the synergies between multiple elements such as units, equipments, and relics, rather than directly grafting a set of deck building gameplay.
After thinking about this problem clearly, I plan to put the focus of the game on tactics. This update is based on this purpose. For example, adjust the basic attributes ​​to make the effect of equipments more significant; continuously display the ATK, DEF and HP info of units to facilitate tactical calculations, etc.
There will be some major adjustments in the future, and even the hero's story stage will be removed, leaving only a brief description of the background information. After all, my time is limited, and it should be spent on focusing on tactics.

[h3]Basic Attributes Adjustment[/h3]
-Unified lowering of the basic ATK and HP values ​​of units to make the effect of equipment more significant
-Accordingly adjusted level difficulty 

[h3]Optimization[/h3]
-Continuously displays unit HP bar and ATK and DEF values HUD
-After the clue is discovered, as long as it is not destroyed by the enemy, it will be automatically obtained when victory
-The current run progress and remaining clues are displayed on the level preparation UI
-When the energy is less than half, it will flash to warn

[h3]Balancing[/h3]
-DEF provided by Bush landscape is adjusted from +3 to +2
-DEF provided by Gravel landscape is adjusted from +6 to +4
-DEF provided by Boulder landscape is adjusted from +9 to +8
-Rare Relic [Victory Banner] removes the additional [Charge I], and the additional [Rapid] is adjusted from +15 to +12

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
-Fixed the problem of two Fountains being too close in the Brawl x2 leve

notes.title: Major Update: 0.3.0
notes.notes:
[h3]New Unit: Priest[/h3]
New base unit with heal capability, and can do damage ignoring enemie's defense. 
And new equips that extend abilities of Priest.

[h3]Some Anniversary Thoughts[/h3]
It has been a whole year since Fountain launched early access.
Looking back on this year, I have gained a lot of new insights into indie game field and made some new friends through the development of this game. I feel very happy to continue this year.
I didn’t choose the word “persist”, which means that I really enjoy this process, so I can keep doing it naturally.
And I have also found my own rhythm. I wanted to update weekly like commercial games, but I found that it can't be done with my spare time, so I changed to update every 2 weeks, and now I am able to adapt it.

Back to the game itself, the subsequent development plan for this year is as follows:
1.Complete the priest theme content: new levels, new heroes, new relics
2.Epic Relics: add new variations to the build and inject new rhythm into battle
3.Food System: provide one-time buff items, like the potions in Slay the Spire, they can make changes to the game, and also reflect the survival background of lack of food in the world view of "Fountain"
4.Reconstruct the level design: I have been adjusting the build side before. After the Epic Relics and Food System are added, the general structure of the build side is formed. Looking back now, the level design was very rough. I have accumulated a lot of ideas in the past year, and I can't wait to add them to the game.

In addition, although I am very happy with it, it really doesn't sell well, haha.
At the beginning, I missed a lot of exposure opportunities because I didn't understand the mechanism of Steam. It would be great if the exposure mechanism of steam could be improved.
And my time is mainly on development, so I haven't done much promotion and community operation. In this year I will try to do it, such as making some game videos, maintaining player communities, etc., so that more players can see and like "Fountain".

In short, making independent games is a very happy thing, so keep working!

notes.title: Update 0.2.11: Relics
notes.notes:
I haven't updated this game for more than a month. I was a bit lazy because of the Chinese New Year holiday. This time I will update more. I also wish you all happy Chinese New Year.
This update mainly makes a relatively large adjustment to Relic. At first, the strength of relics is remarkable increased to make them more useful in battle. Second, the synergy between the relics is also increased. So that the relics can make some builds. Now the conception of this game is gradually becoming a combination of [Advanced Warfare], [Fire Emblem] and [Slay the Spire]. However, although I added a lot of new contents, the battle still feels a bit messy. The subsequent plan is to add a healing unit, and then try to do some subtraction in this game to make the game more compact and refined.
In addition, it has been almost a year since EA in March last year. Looking back on this year, as a game developed in my spare time, the added content is not small. I am very satisfied. I have always believed that games should be paid for content, so this time I will adjust the price, which can be regarded as an explanation for my efforts in the past year.

notes.title: Chat: Level Design
notes.notes:
Currently, I am doing follow-up content development. So there is no update this week. And I would like share something about this game again.

This time I would like to talk about level design.
In Fountain, levels are designed along these two ideas: [Offense] vs [Defense], [Gathering] vs [Scattering].

Offense and defense, as the name implies, refers to whether the player attacks the enemy or defends the enemy. Gathering and scattering refers to whether the units are gathered together or scattered all over the map.
Occupy level is that player offense, enemy defense, player and enemy are both gathering. Compete level is player and enemy are both offense and gathering. Decapitate level is player offense+gathering, enemy defense+scattering. Escape level is player offense+scattering, enemy defense+scattering. Defense and protect levels are of course player defense+gathering, enemy offense+scattering. Their difference is the defense object is still or moving.
Generally speaking, some lineups are good at offense, such as cavalry based lineups. Some are good at defense, such as infantry+archers. So when choosing a level, choose the one that current lineup is better at dealing with, is the key to advance to later stages.

As for gathering and scattering, gathered units can cooperate better to make a strong combat force. Some friends said that in occupy level archers gathering around a fountain are difficult to deal with. That is a manifestation of gathering. To handle this situation, the most effective way is to cause casualties to enemy each round, make them less gathering, that can actually weaken the enemy.
Compare to gathering, the combat effectiveness of scattered units is also scattered. It's necessary to consider how to locally gather the scattered unit, to form effective combat force. And it is a big challenge. Of course it will affected by randomness. Such as an archer without effective self-protection ability is randomly placed at a corner with a lot of enemies. In this time, some team mates with high mobility are needed to come to support quickly. Or player can choose to bear certain losses and try to preserve other combat force.
This is also the main reason that some friends asked why there is no pre-combat formation phase in Fountain. It's comfort a good experience to have a well positioned formation at the beginning of combat. And it is also a challenging experience to gradually gather the chaotic formation and form an effective combat force.

From stage 4, since the unit number that player controls has increaced, we hope to make the level more complex. So we introduced a new idea of combination: combining different level types together. Such as occupy+defense, or 2 defense objects: defense+protect. Then the team is needed to be divided into 2 groups, to deal with different level objectives. How to distribute the combat force, and how to support each other, are things worth considering. This is also a extension of scattering.

By the way, let me introduce the developing content. 
Currently I'm working at adding some new abilities and equipments, and adjusting some existing abilities and equipments. Hoping these can increase the richness of build ideas. At the same time, I'm also developing a brand new unit type, including its new abilities, equipments and new level types. Hope I can finish and release it successfully.
I'm doing all this at spare time. The progress is not fast, but I will definitely continue to polish the existing content and add new content.

That’s all. Wish you have a good game time.

notes.title: Chat: About Build
notes.notes:
Currently, I am doing follow-up content development. So there is no update this week. And I would like to share something about this game.

Build is a important part in strategy rogue-like game. I think it's an interesting topic, and I would like to talk something about it.
At first, the build of Fountain was decided to make arround unit types, such as pure cavalry or mixed infantry archer team. Later, new elements were added into it, captain ability, equipment, relic and so on.

Among them, captain ability is a light build guide. Hero Yokai, as an example, his ability is giving all team members Charge I ability. Then the team should be mainly composed by cavalry, so that it can make the Charge ability work by mobility. It can also be combined with infantry, but it's not as effective as cavalry. Archers basicly can not make use of Charge. So when choosing Yokai as captain, the team usually consists of cavalry as main force and followed by infantry.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/3ef27ce670444de8bae50d953bce9549194b36bf.png[/img]

After determining the captain and units, the next step is to select equipments. It can be equipped with various charge equipments to enhance cavalries' offensive power. As for whether it is normal charge, straight charge or extreme charge, it depends on your preference and probability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/b5c53b0de16cc58806c2c733ff2887215a94be9c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/dce4734374f7db9ad5e4f98cc6e4fe87cc4d45c0.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/c487f5a1cfe5be90558f676784ebf9dec095db63.png[/img]

There are some practical equipment combinations, such as straight charge + accelerate, extreme charge + first aid/advance trumpet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/dce4734374f7db9ad5e4f98cc6e4fe87cc4d45c0.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/86ed702c6d5cbb09237c451d3fa665daee3ec952.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/c487f5a1cfe5be90558f676784ebf9dec095db63.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/f661cbb99d9d3b92ee2682d7e8a552b82ad82529.png[/img]

Some friends have complained about the poor survivability of cavalry. It can be equipped with an equipment of survivability. However, cavalry does not have good defensive equipment currently. I'm considering to add some new equipments to solve it.
If there are infantries in the team, they can be equipped with some protection equipment, such as defense aura, rush to rescue, in order to protect the main attackers, cavalries.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/2c8987059bce092d03a2c8561dd34d7f6b9548d5.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/aa181da71cafd0a1de4ee714b265ca4f2d2187e3.png[/img]

In addition, some team members can also be equipped with some functional equipments, such as increasing view range, carry, etc., which will have miraculous effects in specific levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/2438d7a30cf26447300430b3d9e6b5442d3e2a93.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/19e2caf37624257a7be6ac56a1a9780d7e195c5d.png[/img]

In terms of relics, continuing to use Yokai as an example, the first choice is Ker's Stone: after attack with Burst, gain Power+2. All attack with Charge is also with Burst. So it's easy to stack up ATK. But we must protect the units with high stacked ATK, otherwise it will be a waste. Other choices come down to personal preference. If you like something more stable, choose some relics with recovery ability. If you like something more aggressive, choose one with offensive ability.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/eca853458429e0490aaebb320241967d46b96f85.png[/img]

As for the choice of heroes, priorty must be given to cavalry heroes: Bell, Fred.
When it comes to hero equipment selection, take Yokai as an example. His extra ability is Straight Charge, so I like to equip him with another Straight Charge equipment. The superimposed effect is very significant.
Then I like to coupled it with a cloak with Accelerate ability. After the mobility is increased, it's easy to ouput tons of damage. Of course, we need to pay attention to positioning. Except for keeping a proper distance from enemies, we should try to be in the same straight line with enemy. And it's best to have a path with road landscape. Then the Straight Charge ability can have the maxium effect.
For the third piece of equipment, we can choose one with survivability, such as +HP/DEF. Although it may not surely save cavalry's life, it's worth it to increase 1 or 2 attack opportunities.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/dce4734374f7db9ad5e4f98cc6e4fe87cc4d45c0.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/86ed702c6d5cbb09237c451d3fa665daee3ec952.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/fdf782bc8b249f466ba9ba07e12e0503cb254bf4.png[/img]

As a cavalry regiment, Yokai's team needs to pay attention to the factors the besides the build. We should try to choose landscape with less obstacles to play the role of mobility+Charge. The combat strategy is giving priority to focus fire to form an effective kill. Then the enemy's damage output capability will be reduced next turn.

Moreover, some friends said the level with crowded archers is difficult. One solution of Yokai's build is bringing one or two infantries with Taunt and defensive abilities to force archers to attack them. Then let cavalries wipe out archers that are easy to focus fire. In level with pursuers or other levels with time pressure, infantries are not easy to get to front line in time. One or two cavalries with Carry ability can be miraculous.


At last, let me preview the subsequent updates: the final boss level has been redesigned, and an ending plot has been added. Then Fountain will become more complete since its first release in March. In the future, we will continuously add new game modes, units, heroes, equipments, relic, levels, etc. Of course, it is also important to continue to optimize bad experiences and fix bugs.

That’s all. Wish you have a good game.

notes.title: Rare Relic Joins!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

There will be a medium update in early May.

[h3]Rare Relics[/h3]
An enthusiastic friend mentioned in mail before that "Fountain" as a roguelike game still has shortcomings in build, and I agree very much. At first I thought it was enough to have the captain ability to guide build, but now I feel it's still a little short of that. So I'll try to use "Rare Relics" to enhance the build aspect, and make each build can have different feeling.

There will be a change to obtain Rare Relics as reward. They have much more impact on the combat than common ones. Take the "Loyalty Medal" as an example:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/1b21bc567558bc2c88f072d020150cc0f0175dff.png[/img]
-Our [Rush To Rescue] has no CD, and can trigger [Sentinel I] after rescuing
-Our unit with [Rush To Rescue] gain 2 ROUNDS 15% damage [Power] when ally in rescue range get damaged

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/01c55566a902d3d61331dc8607616686cbe1e54f.gif[/img]

Get the equipment Courage Medal as much as possible to make Loyalty Medal play a greater role. Of course, adding Sam with "Rush To Rescue" ability to our team is also a guaranteed choice.

Another rare relic: Butcher's Knife
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/c5c15cabda75032d74dd545a7d957019933b3447.png[/img]
-When enemy with [Overwhelmed] was defeated, units who damaged it after overwhelmed recover HP equal to the amount of [Overwhelmed]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/f1a812679c259e1348ce010529d7bb9d9388c210.gif[/img]

It can create synergy with abilities that can cause [Overwhelmed].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/a8a2e883ad81e413415580a9fd42002e9d382476.png[/img]

There are total 14 Rare Relics that will be released soon, and they will be released in two batches, with each batch containing 7 pieces.

Hope you will enjoy it!

notes.title: Chat
notes.notes:
It has been more than a month since Fountain released. Looking back at the announcements I had written, I suddenly realized that I was making an independent game. Why should I wrote announcements seriously like a game company... It just happened that there wasn't much update content this week, so I want to write something else, to chat with everyone.

Let’s first talk about why we start this game. The idea came to me when my wife was pregnant with my daughter. I thought that I was going to have my own child. As someone who likes games, I should try to have my own game, so I talked to my partner artist and started this project.

Because I'm not very good at action games, I play strategy games more. The ones that most influenced me were Fire Emblem and Advance Wars from Nintendo. I like the fantasy background of Fire Emblem and the combat system of Advance Wars. So I try to combine the two into one game. The cavalry in Fountain is similar to the tank or armored vehicle in Advance Wars, the infantry is infantry, and the archers correspond to artillery or rocket launchers. The archer has blind area and can't attack after moving also come from Advance Wars. You guys who have played Advance Wars will probably feel this.

In addition, I played a lot of roguelike games, and I also like the turn-based Deck Builder game. However, there are already many such games, so I want to integrate turn-based tactic with roguelike more. I have also played one of the best roguelike turn-based tactic games, such as "Into the Breach" for dozens of hours. In Fountain, I wanted to make some different flavors. So I started my attempt.

By the way, let’s talk about the current development content - "Rare Relics". Rare Relics will have a more significant impact in commbat than the common ones. Such as the "Loyalty Medal", which cancel the cooldown of our unit's "Rush to Rescue" and launch an "Sentinel I" after rescue. Bell and Sam are the start heroes. In order not to introduce complex abilities too early, their captain abilities are simple +ATK/DEF. This rare relic "Loyalty Medal" can be regarded as a little compensation for Sam (of course Bell also has another one) . The first release of some rare relics is expected to be in late April.
OK, enough chatting, I'm going to test the new relics now.

notes.title: New Heroes Join!
notes.notes:
Hi, guys.
There will be a medium-sized content update of Fountain in early April.

Although It was small at the beginning, didn’t have much content, and had many experience problems. But believe that we will continue to improve the experience and add content. Especially the enthusiastic feedback we have recently received from some player friends has given us great confidence and motivation to gradually present the complete imagination of this game in our mind.

[h1]3 New Heroes[/h1]

[h2]Lonely Knight - Fred[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/9e5236b21983865439cecf1bb06c53c07c546c6a.png[/img]
[b]Human Cavalry[/b]
Fred, an aged knight who stands alone in the barrier and uphold fairness and justice. What is he worried about?

[b]Extra ability [Advance Trumpet I][/b] gives teammates on the move path temporarily [Charge I] ability. Use it with a good formation and timing to unleash a wave of explosions.
[b]Captain ability [One For All][/b] gives all teammates [Siege I] ability. It can lead to a build that highly rely on good formation.

[h2]Kind Loser - Pachikon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/8c7c531a6853c763dd1776a3b3a17d9285cfed6f.png[/img]
[b]Barbarian Infantry[/b]
Not all gangsters in the barrier are evil. How did the kind-hearted loser Pachicon survive?

[b]Extra ability [Forced March I][/b] gives Pachikon higher mobility than normal infantries. But it has a cool down time. Choose the right timing to use.
[b]Captain ability [All For One][/b], cavalry teammates gain [Penetrate I], infantry [Cleave I](except Pachikon himself, after all he is a loser). It's time to try a AOE based build.

[h2]Gangster Girl - Leaf[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/989db513751062416650b9c337d7c3d76da1c83a.png[/img]
[b]Human Archer[/b]
Leaf, an orphan girl raised by a gang, has never been exposed to the world outside the barrier. Does she also look forward to leaving the barrier?

[b]Extra ability [Extreme Maneuver I][/b] allows archer to shoot after move, with a cost of gaining high [Fatigue]. It depends on player's choice.
[b]Captain ability [Fatigue And Rest][/b] gives all team members high addition ATK. But gain [Fatigue] after attack. Stay on road or grass can ease fatigue. It seems can build a squad with some equipments and abilities with fatigue.

[h1]Increase Hero's Max Level And Outfit Parts Change Function[/h1]
The maximum level of hero will increase to 7. Hero will unlock an outlook part at each level from 5 to 7.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/bebaef0c43f802426bf03ba808928038a9ac8e85.gif[/img]

By continuing to use favorite heroes, you can get fresh looks without worrying about wasting EXP.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/6de283b215977a412bd3a5855c841f92c5340ca1.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890707/b2297307216f605bed71894ee57e70cf115c2127.gif[/img]

Updates of UI, tutorial iteration, operation improvements, more opportunities to reunite with hero companions, etc.
